on_screen_facts: Victory to You, O Unborn, Invincible Lord of all! O Lord who strolls on the banks of the Chandrabhaga, Supreme Brahman and Consort of Rukmini, Friend of the humble—protect me!
images.reason_new: New typography image for verse 1 of opening invocation

on_screen_facts: Without Your grace and support, O Lord, all efforts are mere exhaustion. If there is no life-breath within the body, who cares for a corpse?
images.reason_new: New typography image for verse 2 of opening invocation

on_screen_facts: The divine beauty of a lake, O Padmanabha, exists because of its water. The juicy pulp inside a fruit gives value even to its outer rind.
images.reason_new: New typography image for verse 3 of opening invocation

on_screen_facts: In the very same way, Your grace empowers those who surrender to You. Remove my sins, sorrows, and destitution—this alone is my prayer.
images.reason_new: New typography image for verse 4 of opening invocation
